column.rationale: Retain the documented semantic contract and known table producer/consumer boundary; no contradictory ownership, duplication, or recovery evidence was found.

index.rationale: Retain the named index because its leading columns support a current filter, join, or ordering path and no covering autoindex proves it redundant.

physical_relation.rationale: Retain the physical relation because it enforces the documented ownership and deletion contract for current databases.

application_relation.rationale: Retain the application relation because polymorphic, projection, snapshot, or source-path identity intentionally cannot use one ordinary SQLite foreign key and current producers apply its lifecycle rule.

sources.rationale: Required stable parent registry for every imported source domain; scan producers and cross-domain consumers depend on its IDs and kind uniqueness.

source_files.rationale: Required rebuildable fingerprint and retry ledger; it separates scan state from normalized descendants and drives idempotent ingestion.

external_source_instances.rationale: Required non-rebuildable local identity for independently configured external access boundaries; provider capability observations and later source Items depend on its stable ID.

external_source_capabilities.rationale: Required latest rebuildable capability observation; its one-to-one lifecycle preserves fail-closed availability and policy-version evidence without mixing user-managed Source Instance identity.

workspaces.rationale: Required stable Project identity and current browse target; SET NULL children and polymorphic links preserve user organization when discovery changes.

sessions.rationale: Required normalized Session identity, parent hierarchy, activity boundary, retrieval source, and Usage Record parent under approved PRD-0002 contracts.

activity_events.rationale: The normalized event table remains required; FEAT-0032 removed its unused generic metadata slot after an all-null runtime preflight while preserving event identity, content, provenance, and ordering.

session_pins.rationale: Required non-rebuildable owner recall intent for eligible primary work Sessions; row presence, one-to-one cascade ownership, and database-backup recovery remain separate from source-derived Session facts.

session_reference_scans.rationale: Required aggregate source/extractor freshness and 100-target bound for one primary work Session; it keeps failed reconciliation stale rather than guessing from detail reads.

session_reference_evidence.rationale: Required source-neutral privacy-minimized Session reference locations and completed read outcomes; it separates Session-facing evidence from Activity Event content, shared target metadata, and user organization.

usage_price_snapshots.rationale: Required immutable price provenance cited by Usage Records; RESTRICT deletion protects historical calculation evidence.

usage_model_prices.rationale: Required versioned Decimal price inputs, including approved long-context tiers, under passed PRD-0004.

usage_records.rationale: The Usage Record table and frozen attribution remain required; FEAT-0031 restores the three-value compatible CHECK through backup-backed exact-value preservation without absorbing deferred timestamp metadata.

context_roots.rationale: Required non-rebuildable user source registration and enablement boundary; normalized documents cannot reconstruct this selection intent.

context_documents.rationale: The rebuildable corpus remains required and FEAT-0030 added the source and Project lookup indexes selected by the current query prefixes.

workstreams.rationale: Required top-level user-curated organization and physical parent; scans cannot recover its identity, wording, or grouping intent.

threads.rationale: Required ordered non-rebuildable work subdivision with current goals and resource ownership.

workstream_links.rationale: Required reviewed heterogeneous Workstream membership; application validation and historical unresolved-target behavior are intentional.

thread_links.rationale: Required reviewed heterogeneous Thread membership; inference cannot reproduce accepted scope and provenance.

local_resources.rationale: The curated resource table remains required; FEAT-0030 removed its redundant named path index while preserving the UNIQUE(path) autoindex.

external_resources.rationale: Required curated external-reference identity; stable ID, local title, provenance, and memberships are not source-rebuildable, while URL identity is source-scoped rather than globally unique.

atlassian_sites.rationale: Required stable domain/tenant identity independent of optional access; local Items and Spaces must survive without a Provider or Source Instance.

atlassian_site_bindings.rationale: Required explicit user-managed relation between a domain-first Site and independently configured Source Instance; it prevents Provider and configuration identity from becoming Site identity.

atlassian_spaces.rationale: Required optional Site-scoped Jira project or Confluence Space containment and refresh-scope identity.

atlassian_items.rationale: Required strict one-to-one source-specific extension of the stable External Resource ID; it prevents a second local Item identity from severing user relations.

atlassian_item_urls.rationale: Required Site-scoped normalized URL identity plus exact observed canonical and alias links; global External Resource URL uniqueness cannot represent this boundary.

atlassian_item_remote_state.rationale: Required bounded remote metadata, check/version evidence, and retained unavailable/stale state separate from local fields and body content.

atlassian_item_content.rationale: Required source-preserving body, deterministic normalization, content hash, and FTS projection fingerprint separate from remote metadata.

atlassian_item_local_state.rationale: Required non-rebuildable user note boundary; remote refresh and evidence reconciliation cannot own or reconstruct this local memory.

atlassian_classifications.rationale: Required reusable local Topic/Tag vocabulary with case-insensitive identity and Topic-only descriptions, independent from remote labels and Workstream membership.

atlassian_item_classifications.rationale: Required user-confirmed Item-to-Topic/Tag membership; the classification-first index serves current browse filters while cascading ownership removes only local assignments.

atlassian_evidence_scans.rationale: Required source/extractor/configured-Site freshness boundary so unchanged eligible local inputs skip parsing while contract or configuration changes re-evaluate without remote access.

atlassian_item_evidence.rationale: Required derived source-separated URL sightings with exact Session/Document location and stable Item identity; it avoids excerpt and opaque provider-payload duplication.

suggestions.rationale: Required generated review queue and accepted/rejected history; refresh semantics explicitly preserve protected decisions.

checkpoints.rationale: Confirmed snapshots remain non-rebuildable; FEAT-0030 added the Workstream/version index without transforming any snapshot row.

checkpoint_resource_refs.rationale: Historical resource snapshots remain required; FEAT-0030 removed the redundant named index while preserving the four-column UNIQUE autoindex.

maintenance_runs.rationale: Operational history and artifact correlation remain required; FEAT-0037 gives compatible databases the same optional Workstream SET NULL relation through a backup-backed, exact-value-preserving repair.

external_sync_runs.rationale: Required one-to-one source-neutral query projection for external synchronization; it keeps Source Instance, service, scope, target count, manifest version, and read-policy evidence queryable without duplicating detailed private manifest inputs.

search_index.rationale: Required fully derived FTS projection; explicit lifecycle deletion and full rescan recovery make its application relations appropriate.

unused_fields: FEAT-0032 removed the supported unused Activity Event metadata field after all-null preflight
duplicated_facts: Session/event counts retained as rebuildable summary caches
Session reference evidence stores only bounded observed identity and source location rather than copying Activity Event text or shared target content
External capability JSON is the canonical minimal logical-operation projection rather than duplicated Source Instance identity
The external-sync relational row is a bounded query projection derived atomically from the versioned detailed Run manifest
wrong_ownership: No existing table owner move proposed; all 39 objects have exactly one Data Model subject owner, including separate user-owned Session pins, source-neutral Session reference evidence, and the Atlassian domain-first Site, explicit access binding, source-specific evidence, and local-classification extensions.
polymorphic_referential_gaps: All 24 application relations retained; add_link validates live targets, historical unresolved links are intentional, and projection/source correlations have explicit cleanup
identifier_inconsistencies: INTEGER local identities and TEXT stable/source/run identities retained by authority boundary; polymorphic entity_id remains TEXT by contract
missing_or_redundant_indexes: FEAT-0030 removed three proven redundant names and added query-prefix indexes; FEAT-0045 adds external-sync prefixes; FEAT-0046 adds Site, Space, Item, URL, canonical-URL, and freshness query coverage; FEAT-0047 adds Item, Session-location, and Document-location evidence prefixes; FEAT-0050 adds the classification-first membership prefix used by Topic/Tag browse filters; FEAT-0062 adds Source-first Site-binding lookup coverage; FEAT-0072 adds Session-target grouping plus Document and Atlassian target lifecycle prefixes.
status_and_type_constraints: FEAT-0072 directly constrains reference scan state, target kind, evidence kind, read outcome, target/FK shape, completed tool identity, and the 100-target boundary; FEAT-0044 constrains provider, service, enabled, and capability availability; FEAT-0031 resolved Usage attribution and FEAT-0035 resolved Session class/index policy
stable_data_in_json: Session reference target, evidence, outcome, source location, and counts are relational and retain no copied message or opaque tool JSON; External capability JSON retains only canonical sorted logical-operation names; the external-sync envelope owns query fields; Atlassian metadata and normalized documents are bounded versioned payloads while Site, Space, Item, URL, version, hash, coverage, attention, freshness, and source evidence identity remain relational.
deletion_behavior: Session reference scan/evidence rows cascade from their Session and exact target without deleting the target; Session pin rows cascade only when their owning Session is deleted; the external-sync extension cascades with its maintenance parent; Atlassian Site descendants restrict accidental Site deletion while access binding and nullable Source Instance pointers can be removed without deleting local identity; source deletion clears only derived evidence; explicit External Resource purge cascades source-specific Item extensions; unavailable results retain last-known state.
fresh_vs_compatible_drift: Idempotent schema application creates the FEAT-0072 Session reference tables and indexes, FEAT-0058 Session pin table, and FEAT-0044/0045/0046/0047/0050/0062 additive tables; the backup-backed External Resource rebuild removes only global URL uniqueness while preserving rows and polymorphic relations; the backup-backed Atlassian repair makes legacy Site access optional and backfills bindings plus Item/Space access ownership; canonical-timestamp-contract remains deferred.
